title: Sunday · the Rain, at a third
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (A Third of a Page · deepening)
logline: June, but the January composition — the garage sill, three jars — drawn to the third-page grid. The jars barely fit. The lower two-thirds of the page: the newspaper's ads, drawn in.

panels.composition: Tier 1 (a third the usual height): the sill, three jars, rain. Cramped. The top jar's brushes cut off by the tier's top edge.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rust, a very shallow tier showing three jars on a rainy windowsill with the brushes in the tallest jar cut off by the top edge, no words
image.notes: The Sunday is drawn at one-third height. The remaining two-thirds are the paper's ads, drawn as gray blocks.

panels.name: Sill, cramped

panels.composition: Tier 2: the lamp on the table, the chair, and — because there's no room — no bed beneath. The pup's ear at the bottom edge.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rust, a very shallow tier with a lamp on a table and a chair and a small dog's ear just visible at the bottom edge, no words

panels.name: No room

panels.composition: Tier 3: the ads. Drawn: gray blocks, a car dealership's shape, a tide table. The strip draws its own neighbors.

image.prompt: gray ink blocks suggesting newspaper advertisements and a tide table, drawn as shapes without legible text, no words
image.notes: Two-thirds of the page: the paper's ads, drawn as shapes. Letter nothing.

panels.name: The ads
